dataNote: Yahoo 5-min futures data through 7:06 AM ET (feed runs ~10 min behind). Prior day = Oct 7 Globex session (6 pm Oct 6 to 5 pm Oct 7).
headline: London swept sell-side liquidity: Asian low and prior-day low taken on both ES and NQ. Price is holding just above the London low going into NY.
smt: No SMT divergence yet. ES and NQ both took the Asian low and PDL at the same 6:30 low. Watch the London low after 9:30: if one index trades below it and the other holds, that is bullish SMT.
htf: Daily: rally from the Oct 1 low (7672.75) to the Oct 6 high (7897.50), then a down day on Oct 7 and a lower open today. Price is back at the middle of that leg, just above its 50% level (~7785).

steps.text: Sell-side taken in London (Asian low + PDL). A second sweep of the London low (7802.75 ES / 31119.75 NQ) after 9:30 would be the classic TJR long trigger.
Needed: a bullish BOS (close above the last swing high) plus an IFVG. Nothing before 9:50; 9:30–9:50 is the manipulation window.
Entries only in the 9:50–10:10 macro, at the FVG / equilibrium of the BOS leg.
Buy-side above: London high 7837.25, midnight open 7847.75, Asian high 7858.25 (NQ: 31294, 31368.5, 31466).

invalidation: If price accepts below the London low and the ~7785 EQ with a bearish BOS, the bullish idea is off. The draw then becomes the Oct 5 low (7760.25 ES / 30957.50 NQ). A short would need a buy-side sweep first (e.g. into 7815–7837) plus a bearish BOS.
reminder: The v4 backtest lost on wick-tight stops. A stop under the London low is ~5 pts from current price, which is noise-sized.
